The '''StreetBoss 50-50''' was a [[landspeeder]] produced by [[Byblos TurboDrive]]. It was mainly used in [[Canto Bight]] on the planet [[Cantonica]]. It was constructed in a simple, rectangular shape. While there were two open seats in the back, which offered space for a pilot and a passenger, there were power turbines on the sides, which were not revealed in contrast to many other landspeeders. In addition to some other system modifications, [[Hulb Toxx]] also equipped his StreetBoss with a [[personal defense energy field]] that would push away any person that got too close to the speeder.<ref name="TLJICS" />
